Mumbai 400 051. Scrip Code: 539523 Scrip Symbol: ALKEM Sub: Update on US FDA Inspection at Company’s manufacturing facility located at Amaliya, Daman Dear Sir/Madam, This is in continuation of our earlier intimations dated August 6, 2026 and May 2, 2026, regarding the US FDA inspection conducted at the Company’s manufacturing facility located at Amaliya, Daman, from April 20, 2026 to May 1, 2026. The US FDA had classified the inspection status of the said facility as Official Action Indicated (OAI). This is to inform you that US FDA has issued a warning letter dated November 18, 2026 for Company’s manufacturing facility located at Amaliya, Daman. The Company shall be responding to the US FDA within stipulated timeline. The Company continues to manufacture and supply approved products from the said facility to the U.S. market. The details as required under Clause 20 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of SEBI Listing Regulations is enclosed herewith as Annexure A. Kindly take the same on record. corporate_announcements.subject: Reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
corporate_announcements.summary: Gensol Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: T: +91 7248777752 Gensol Engineering Ltd E: cirpgensolengg@gmail.com A2-12th Floor, Palladium, Opp. Vodafone House, Corporate Road, Prahlad Nagar Ahmedabad – 380015, Gujarat Correspondence Address: MiQB Executive Coworking Space, Plot 23, Sector 18, Maruti Industrial Development Area, Gurugram, Haryana – 122015 19.11.2026 To, The Manager Listing Compliance Department National Stock Exchange of India Limited Exchange Plaza, Bandra Kurla Complex Bandra (East), Mumbai – 400051 NSE Symbol – GENSOL Subject: Reply regarding Non-submission of Financial Results for the Quarter/Half Year Ended September 30, 2026 Dear Sir/Madam, This is with reference to your communication regarding the non-intimation of the Board Meeting for consideration and approval of the Financial Results and non-submission of the Financial Results for the quarter/half year ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. In this regard, we have already intimated to the Exchange that, pursuant to the order dated June 13, 2025, passed by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench ("NCLT"), Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ("CIRP") has been initiated against Gensol Engineering Limited ("Corporate Debtor") under Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 ("IBC"). Pursuant thereto, the undersigned has been appointed as the Resolution Professional ("RP") for conducting the CIRP in accordance with the provisions of the IBC and the applicable regulations. Consequent to the commencement of CIRP, the affairs of the Company are being managed in accordance with the provisions of the IBC under the supervision of the appointed Resolution Professional. The Company is presently facing significant operational, financial and administrative constraints in relation to its statutory and regulatory compliances, including the finalisation, preparation and approval of the Financial Results for the quarter/half year ended September 30, 2026. Further, due to the ongoing CIRP proceedings and the prevailing circumstances of the Corporate Debtor, the Company has been facing difficulties in arranging the requisite information, records and resources necessary for the preparation and finalisation of the Financial Results within the prescribed timelines. In view of the above circumstances, we respectfully request the Exchange to kindly take note of the Company's ongoing CIRP proceedings and consider the special circumstances under which the aforesaid delay/non- compliance has occurred. We assure the Exchange that the Company, through the Resolution Professional, shall make appropriate efforts to address the pending compliance requirements and undertake necessary steps for the preparation and submission of the Financial Results in accordance with the applicable provisions of law and the directions of the Hon'ble NCLT, wherever applicable. We request your good office to kindly take the above submission on record and consider our representation sympathetically. Thanking you. Yours faithfully, For Gensol Engineering Limited (Company under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process) The powers of the Board of Directors are suspended and are being exercised by the Resolution Professional appointed by the Hon'ble NCLT. On Behalf of Gensol Engineering Limited (Resolution Professional) (In the Matter of Gensol Engineering Limited) IBBI Registration No.: IBBI/IPA-002/IP-N01131/2021-2022/13759 C-7, Parth
